headline: Bitcoin is steady near $74,000 while stocks bounce, as traders put the odds of a December Fed rate hike at about 90%; MSCI says at about 5pm ET Wednesday (05:00 Thursday Bangkok) whether it will drop Strategy from its indexes.

market.asOf: Read from CoinMarketCap (BTC, SOL), CoinGecko (ETH) and alternative.me at about 11:58 UTC Wed 11 Nov (18:58 Bangkok; 6:58am ET). Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 32, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 29 the day before. CoinDesk cites a Fear and Greed Index reading of 26.

stories.title: Bitcoin sits out a stock rebound as traders bet on a December rate hike
stories.summary: After hotter-than-expected US inflation on Tuesday, bitcoin dipped to about $72,700 and then steadied near $74,000, even as US stock futures rose. Traders now see a Fed rate hike on 9 December as very likely. Higher rates make borrowing dearer and safe bonds pay more, which tends to weigh on risky assets like crypto.
points: October consumer prices rose 0.4% against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per CoinDesk and KuCoin.
CME FedWatch odds of a December hike rose to 90%, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin briefly fell to $72,727 on Tuesday, per Ted Pillows' market report, and was little changed around $74,000 early Wednesday, per CoinDesk.
About $725M of crypto bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours; bitcoin's share was $200.5M, 85% of them bets on rising prices, per CoinDesk.
Nasdaq-100 futures rose 1.7% after CoreWeave's results beat forecasts, per CoinDesk.

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose money for a fourth day in a row
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows again on Tuesday, though about half Monday's size. These funds are how most US retail and adviser money reaches bitcoin, so steady outflows mean less buying support.
points: Tuesday 10 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $95M net, the fourth day of outflows in a row, per SoSoValue data cited by Bitcoin.com.
BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $78M, its eighth straight day of redemptions, per CoinDesk.
Monday 9 Nov: $201.1M left, with IBIT down $213.2M, per Bitcoin.com.
US spot ether ETFs also had a fourth day of outflows, about $1.3M on 10 Nov, per Bitcoin.com.

stories.title: MSCI decides tonight whether to drop Strategy from its indexes
stories.summary: At about 5pm ET on Wednesday (05:00 Thursday Bangkok), MSCI announces its November index changes under new rules for 'non-operating companies'. Strategy, the biggest corporate bitcoin buyer, is a candidate for removal. Funds that copy the index would then need to sell the stock; it would stay listed on Nasdaq.
points: Results come shortly after 11:00pm CET Wed 11 Nov; changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
Strategy bought 1,036 BTC last week and now holds 850,364 BTC, per Bitcoin.com.
Strategy shares closed at $121.07 on 10 Nov, down from $145.16 on 28 Oct, per Bitcoin.com.
JPMorgan estimated about $2.8B of selling by index funds, an estimate made for an earlier version of the rules, per Bitcoin.com.

briefs.title: Initia hacked for $3.27M
briefs.summary: An attacker got into Initia's infrastructure and approved forged withdrawals from five rollups; Initia halted its network and says no INIT was taken, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Zcash keeps sliding
briefs.summary: ZEC fell 11.8% in 24 hours to about $1,014, leading the day's declines, per Analytics Insight.

briefs.title: Tougher US crypto rules may be coming
briefs.summary: House Democrats are reported to be preparing a market structure bill with a bigger role for the SEC; no draft has been published yet, per Forbes.

briefs.title: Options on crypto funds get easier to list

briefs.title: Coinbase wins final approval for a national trust bank
briefs.summary: The OCC gave Coinbase National Trust Company final approval, moving its institutional custody under federal oversight, per Decrypt.
